style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Faux Norfolk Pine Christmas Wreath
style.toneOfVoice: Bring effortless greenery to your home with this artificial 61cm faux Norfolk pine wreath, a beautifully full and natural-looking decorative piece designed to capture the delicate charm of real Norfolk pine. Featuring soft, feathery pine needles in layered tones of green, this wreath creates a fresh, woodland-inspired look that feels both elegant and timeless. The generous 61cm diameter makes it a striking addition to front doors, interior walls, or mantel displays, while the realistic faux foliage offers all the beauty of natural greenery without the upkeep. Its versatile design works beautifully throughout the festive season but is subtle enough to complement winter décor long after Christmas. Crafted for lasting style, this wreath will stay vibrant year after year, making it a reliable go-to piece for seasonal decorating. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions. Wreath width: 61cm. Wipe clean with a soft cloth.
